entries.title: Governance artifacts conflated specification and operational authority
entries.reason_accepted: Operational governance was functioning through proposal-shaped files, creating ambiguity for both humans and AI agents.
required_resolution: Create live ledgers
Create authority manifest
Separate specification history from operational state
entries.notes: Resolved on 2026-07-01 after live authority was made explicit through the governance constitution, authority manifest, live debt discharge command, and proposal-metadata cleanup in live ledgers.

entries.title: Department peer layout remains incomplete
entries.reason_accepted: The constitutional department model is ahead of the current filesystem rollout.
required_resolution: Create mathematics department root
Induct economics as peer department or explicitly exempt it
Induct theology as peer department or explicitly exempt it
entries.notes: Resolved on 2026-07-02 by creating peer roots for mathematics, economics, and theology under departments/ and recording a live placeholder-root rule that keeps induction debt separate from bare layout normalization.

entries.title: Physics local SSOT naming remains non-normalized
entries.reason_accepted: The file exists and is usable, but its name diverges from the shared department convention.
required_resolution: Rename or ratify exception
entries.notes: Resolved on 2026-07-02 by normalizing the local physics SSOT filename to departments/physics/department_ssot.md and updating live routing references.

required_resolution: Create departments/economics/
Add local SSOT and local AGENTS.md or explicitly mark exception

entries.title: Approved tool registry lacks routing metadata
entries.reason_accepted: Tool approval exists, but deterministic routing still lacks path, invocation, schema, and allowed-use metadata.
required_resolution: Extend tool manifest
Separate allowed use from rigor level
Declare invocation contracts

entries.title: Canonical lexicon remains largely unclassified
entries.reason_accepted: The canonical lexicon acts as authority, but most entries still lack ontology class and definition mode completion.
required_resolution: Classify ontology class
Classify definition mode
Separate true canonical terms from provisional scaffolds
entries.notes: Seeded from live audit rather than from a pre-existing registry entry.

entries.title: Formal semantics of (*|*) remain unresolved
entries.reason_accepted: The induction clarifies usage but does not yet decide whether (*|*) is schema, form, operator-family ancestor, relation-template, or meta-form.
required_resolution: Define the semantics class of (*|*)
State forbidden object-reification readings
Bind the definition to whole-expression governance
entries.notes: Resolved on 2026-07-02 by defining (*|*) in the live primitive-form resolution manifest as a whole-expression primitive relation-schema, forbidding object-reification and temporal-generator readings, and binding downstream use to whole-expression governance.

entries.title: Dominant domain remains undefined
entries.reason_accepted: A|E is named as the canonical dominant-domain realization, but the criteria for dominance are not yet formalized.
required_resolution: Define dominant domain criteria
Explain why A|E is canonical rather than optional
Separate domain privilege from ontology privilege
entries.notes: Resolved on 2026-07-02 by defining dominant-domain criteria in the live dominant-domain resolution manifest, explaining why A|E is canonical rather than optional at the current induction layer, and separating domain privilege from ontology privilege.

entries.title: Relation between (*|*) and A|E is underspecified
entries.reason_accepted: The induction forbids temporal derivation language, but the lawful replacement relation has not been fixed.
required_resolution: Choose between realization, instantiation, typing, contextualization, or projection
Document the non-temporal relation rule
Audit examples for compliance
entries.notes: Resolved on 2026-07-02 by defining the (*|*) to A|E relation as a whole-expression realization relation in the live realization manifest, with an explicit non-temporal rule and rejected replacement readings.

entries.title: D(*|*) usage needs alignment audit
entries.reason_accepted: Existing D(*|*) language may ambiguously treat D as prior to (*|*) or conflate bare distinction shorthand with the new primitive-form clarification.
required_resolution: Audit all D(*|*) occurrences
Separate shorthand use from primitive-form use
Patch ambiguous passages
entries.notes: Resolved on 2026-07-02 by adding a live D-notation alignment manifest, clarifying the shorthand boundary in the textbook symmetry block, and keeping the lemma-level D-context references aligned with bare D(*|*) as declared shorthand only.

entries.title: Operator genealogy from (*|*) remains unresolved
entries.reason_accepted: The induction introduces a genealogy claim but does not yet establish whether later operators are realizations, family members, or downstream projections.
required_resolution: Map genealogy for <=>_r and related operators
Distinguish family membership from projection descent
Provide formal support before any promotion
entries.notes: Resolved on 2026-07-02 by adding a live operator genealogy manifest, stating that bare <=> is the root comparison scaffold, classifying <=>_r and r_<=> as projection descendants of that scaffold, and separating closure-family membership from projection descent in the textbook operator scope.

entries.title: Direct validator invocation fails due to import-path handling
entries.reason_accepted: Validation currently succeeds through module invocation but fails when the validator is launched as a file script because package-style imports do not resolve in that mode.
required_resolution: Make direct script invocation and module invocation behave consistently
Update governance documentation to one canonical command
Audit historical patch records that still prescribe the failing command
entries.notes: Resolved on 2026-07-01 after direct invocation and module invocation were made consistent. Canonical governed command remains `python -m scripts.global_validate`. Historical patch records that mention `python scripts/global_validate.py` are retained as non-authoritative history.

entries.title: New inductions are not yet universally routed through a canonical registry plus live queue
entries.reason_accepted: Inductions currently appear across patches, textbook notes, and local registries without one enforced intake path binding registry state, queue state, lexicon gaps, and claim ceilings.
required_resolution: Create a canonical induction registry
Create a live induction queue
Require queue-to-registry binding before induction use
Patch governance and textbook instructions to use the new intake path
entries.notes: Resolved on 2026-07-01 after creating the canonical induction registry, the live induction queue, binding textbook and governance rules to both, and backfilling currently active inductions into the governed intake path.

entries.title: Prevent inferred evidence from being promoted as executed empirical result
entries.reason_accepted: A review-only orientation-locking artifact was previously framed as execution and needed provenance-aware gating.
required_resolution: Implement provenance-aware validator
Require direct harness/run artifacts for executed empirical claims
Retag inferred evidence as review_only or provisional_inference
entries.notes: Resolved on 2026-07-03 by adding provenance-gated schema fields, enforcing direct-run requirements in global validation, and retagging the orientation-locking artifact as review_only. Dedicated orientation-locking harness construction remains campaign work under MT-COUNTEREXAMPLE-001 rather than open provenance-governance debt.

entries.title: D evaluation and projection semantics require discharge
entries.reason_accepted: Bounded, human-approved support now exists for Eval_D domain/codomain, context-threshold behavior, typed preservation, representable-distinction preservation, and the non-collapse boundary. The result remains C1-bounded and does not authorize theorem promotion.
required_resolution: Discharge OBL-D-001D and OBL-D-001E
Retain bounded support records for OBL-D-001A through OBL-D-001C
Add formal or independently checked bounded support
Reaudit theorem eligibility
entries.notes: Resolved bounded on 2026-07-30 after human approval of P127/P128 under registry/governance/patches/D_HUMAN_REVIEW_APPROVAL_P127_P128_20260730_001. The C1 claim ceiling, falsification boundaries, and theorem-promotion block remain active.

entries.title: Analysis Intake induction queue requires Analysis Department discovery binding
entries.reason_accepted: Two preservation-first RT proposal inductions are now queued under the canonical Analysis Intake home, but the Analysis Department must have an explicit debt-registry and source-set binding so crawl can discover them without treating them as reviewed or promoted work.
required_resolution: Include governance/live/research_debt_registry.json in the Analysis Department crawl source set
Include departments/analysis_intake/induction_queue/queue_registry.json in the Analysis Department crawl source set
Retain the two queue entries as INDUCTED, NOT_REVIEWED, and UNQUEUED_FOR_PROMOTION
entries.notes: Queue entries IQ_2026_07_24_037 and IQ_2026_07_24_038 are preserved exactly and remain outside review and promotion. This debt item exists for crawl discoverability and does not authorize analysis execution or claim promotion.
